_comment: The only ignore list for `pnpm scan` and the CI scan jobs. Every entry needs tool, id, targets, reason, owner and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 190 days out). Targets: a repo name, or image:<backend|imaging|web|floor>. An expired entry fails the scan. After editing run: bash scripts/scan.sh sync (rewrites each repo's .github/trivyignore.yaml for CI). HIGH fix clock: 30 days from 2026-10-10.

ignores.reason: source-map-js 1.2.1 (HIGH, fixed 1.2.2) comes in through postcss/vite in each lockfile; the bump touches another owner's pnpm-lock.yaml, so it is a card for each owner (ops/scans/2026-10-10.md)

false positive: wave and review notes quote command lines that BLANK the AI and Stripe keys (`KEY= KEY2=`); no value is present (checked: no sk- string of 20+ characters in any history line of invai-docs except a quoted URL slug)
